message: fix(equipment): repair damaged tools and expose exact skill requirements
purpose: Preserve every integrated tier and crafting change. Let existing blacksmith repair transactions handle tools, expose tool condition in the inventory, and name unmet gathering/crafting skills. Verify all 147 grade tools, repair prices, replay, ownership, bank exclusion, native inventory reachability and existing regressions before integration.

replacements.new:
if (def.Slot != "") text.AppendLine($"Durability: {item.Durability}% · Runes: {item.Runes.Count}/{item.Sockets}");
        else if (def.Type == "tool") text.AppendLine($"Tool durability: {item.Durability}%");

replacements.old:
if (def.Slot != "" && item.Durability < 100)
            parent.AddChild(Ui.Button("Repair at blacksmith", () => Send("repair", item: item.Id), !NearRole("blacksmith")));
Console.WriteLine($"EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE: {passed} groups passed; {toolsChecked} tier tools repaired and replay-checked; total failures {failures.Count}.");
Carrying multiple tools does not stack their benefits.
replacements.new:
Carrying multiple tools does not stack their benefits.

The inventory shows tool durability. A damaged or broken backpack tool can use the same blacksmith repair action as wearable equipment. Repair restores durability and retains the item's identity, rarity, and bonuses. The server checks ownership, distance, health and gold before charging. Banked tools must be withdrawn first. Undamaged tools and consumables cannot use repair.
